title: Ekaślokī
subtitle: A dialogue on the light of awareness

source.edition: The Works of Sri Sankaracharya, vol. 16, Sri Vani Vilas Press, 1910
source.digitalText: Ambuda CC0 1.0; machine-readable text credit: Arun Prasad

units.label: Verse 1
units.deva:
किं ज्योतिस्तव भानुमानहनि मे रात्रौ प्रदीपादिकं
स्यादेवं रविदीपदर्शनविधौ किं ज्योतिराख्याहि मे ।
चक्षुस्तस्य निमीलनादिसमये किं धीर्धियो दर्शने
किं तत्राहमतो भवान्परमकं ज्योतिस्तदस्मि प्रभो ॥
units.translation: “What is your light?” “The sun by day; at night, a lamp and the like serve me.” “Let it be so. When the sun and lamp are seen, what is the light? Tell me.” “The eye.” “When it is closed and so on, what?” “The intellect.” “When the intellect is seen, what is the light there?” “I am.” Therefore, O Lord, you are the supreme light; I am that.

gloss.en: at the time of closing it and so on

units.iast:
kiṃ jyotistava bhānumānahani me rātrau pradīpādikaṃ
syādevaṃ ravidīpadarśanavidhau kiṃ jyotirākhyāhi me |
cakṣustasya nimīlanādisamaye kiṃ dhīrdhiyo darśane
kiṃ tatrāhamato bhavānparamakaṃ jyotistadasmi prabho ||

units.label: Colophon
units.deva: इति श्रीमत्परमहंसपरिव्राजकाचार्यस्य श्रीगोविन्दभगवत्पूज्यपादशिष्यस्य श्रीमच्छङ्करभगवतः कृतौ एकश्लोकी संपूर्णा ॥
units.translation: Thus the Ekaślokī is complete in the work of revered Bhagavat Śaṅkara, the wandering Paramahaṃsa teacher and disciple of the revered Govinda Bhagavatpāda.

gloss.en: of the teacher who is a wandering Paramahaṃsa renunciant
of the disciple of revered Govinda Bhagavatpāda

units.iast: iti śrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakācāryasya śrīgovindabhagavatpūjyapādaśiṣyasya śrīmacchaṅkarabhagavataḥ kṛtau ekaślokī saṃpūrṇā ||
